packages.label: מַלְכוּתָא דִּשְׁמַיָּא
packages.reason: All nodes share the essential nature of holy sovereignty — the divine feminine presence (Shekhinah) that receives and contains the holy. The 'woman who fears God' (Mishlei 31), the Tribes of Yah, the Mistress/Gevirah, and the Sea of Solomon are all expressions of the same receptive, holy, royal quality. They are contrasted in the Torah with the evil maidservant (Shifha Bisha).

packages.label: מֹחִין וְחָכְמָה
packages.reason: All nodes share the essential nature of the upper sefirot / mochin — the intellect, light, and wisdom that flow from above. Abba/Chokhmah and Imma/Binah are the partzufim of the upper intellect; Yah is their divine name; Mochin is the direct term. Hitgalut/Leidah share this nature because in this Torah revelation of Torah IS the birth of the mochin — they are structurally identical. Tzeirei (the vowel of formed light) and the Kamatz/Or HaPashut (concealed light) are the vessel-and-light dynamic that governs how mochin are received — both are bechina expressions of the same light-transmission nature. The compound nodes Abba-ve-Imma and Chokhmah-u-Vinah bridge the B1/B2/B3 raw sub-components, which all belong to this single conceptual domain.

merge_notes.reason: Raw component B1 (2 nodes) — Imma IS Binah; both are bechina of the same sefira. Merged into the mochin package because Binah/Imma are the second of the two upper sefirot explicitly called 'mochin' in this Torah (the Zohar phrase 'siluka de-Yesoda ad Abba ve-Imma' anchors both Abba/Chokhmah and Imma/Binah as mochin). Shared nature: the upper divine intellect.

Raw component B2 (2 nodes) — Abba IS Chokhmah. Merged into the mochin package for the same reason as B1. The Torah explicitly states 'Abba ve-Imma, she-hem bechina Chokhmah u-Vinah.' Shared nature: upper divine intellect.

Raw component C (2 nodes) — 'Hitgalut hi bechina Leidah' is an explicit bechina in this Torah. This dyad belongs with the mochin package because in Torah 36, revelation of Torah = birth of the mochin (the soul receives new mochin from the Tzaddik's Torah). Shared nature: the actualization of divine intellect descending into the world.

Raw component E (2 nodes) — Tzeirei = 'the light taking form according to the vessel.' This is the mechanism by which mochin/Or Pashut actualizes into a particular form. Belongs to the mochin package because the Torah uses this vowel-symbolism specifically to explain how divine light (chokhmah) is received through the kli. Shared nature: actualization and formation of divine light/intellect.

Raw component F (3 nodes) — The simple/undifferentiated light from above = Kamatz/concealed. This is the pre-formed state of divine light before it takes shape in a vessel. Belongs to the mochin package because the Torah's whole discussion of Kamatz-Tzeirei-blessing/curse is about how the Chokhmah-level light descends and is formed. Shared nature: the divine light of the upper intellect in its concealed, primordial state. Note: 'קמיץ וסתים' (E14) and 'קמץ וסתים' (E15) are variant spellings of the same concept; treated as one node.

packages.label: מַלְכוּת הָרְשָׁעָה
packages.reason: Both nodes share the essential nature of the evil feminine sovereignty — the dark side of malkhut, rooted in the spleen (an organ associated with black bile/melancholy in kabbalistic physiology) and manifesting as the kingdom of impurity that opposes the holy Malkhuta di-Shemaya. This is the exact evil mirror of Package 1.
